scripts.log:stats: echo "=== 本周提交统计 ===" && git shortlog -sn --since="7 days ago" | cat
scripts.lint:commits: echo "=== 检查最近 5 条提交规范 ===" && git log -5 --format="%s" | while read msg; do echo "$msg" | grep -qE '^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert|merge)(\(.+\))?: ' && echo "  ✅ $msg" || echo "  ❌ $msg"; done

scripts.test:codec: node scripts/testInferPosterLang.mjs && tsx scripts/testStreamCodec.mjs && tsx scripts/testPaginateCodecBody.mjs && tsx scripts/testMatchLyricCitation.mjs && tsx scripts/testUserAkizakuraPaste.mjs && tsx scripts/testShowRubyPagination.mjs && tsx scripts/testEncoderPrompt.mjs && tsx scripts/testEncoderPromptMatrix.mjs && tsx scripts/testPedagogicalLevelMatrix.mjs && tsx scripts/testPedagogicalLint.mjs && tsx scripts/testDeepSeekPrompt.mjs && tsx scripts/testZhPipeline.mjs && tsx scripts/testQwenPasteRepair.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:codec
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npm run generate:icons && npx cap sync && node scripts/patchIosLaunchScreen.mjs
scripts.cap:sync:live: npm run generate:icons && CAP_SERVER_URL=${CAP_SERVER_URL:-http://$(ipconfig getifaddr en0):5173} npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patchIosLaunchScreen.mjs
scripts.cap:run:ios: npm run build && npx cap run ios
scripts.cap:run:ios:live: npm run cap:sync:live && npx cap run ios
scripts.cap:run:android: npm run build && npx cap run android
